name: How much does it cost to fix a water heater pilot light?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a water heater pilot light?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a water heater pilot light can vary depending on the underlying issue and required parts. If it's a simple relight, there might be no charge or a minimal service fee if a technician is called. Replacing a faulty thermocouple, a common cause, typically costs less than replacing an entire gas control valve. Labor costs for diagnosis and repair also factor in. It's best to get a specific quote after a professional inspection, as prices can vary by location and the complexity of the repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies by issue; a simple relight is inexpensive, but parts like a thermocouple or gas control valve will increase the price.
